_comment: Dual-NSP sample: two independent text models, one per Hexagon NSP core. Requests route by the 'model' field (= model directory name) or an explicit 'slot' field. Copy next to genie-server.py as env_config.json and adjust paths.
_comment_order: SLOT ORDER MATTERS: TEXT_SLOTS is loaded first-to-last, and on SA8255P, the FIRST model has to be a smaller one (e.g. single-CL 1.7B) or the second fails to load with 'err 1002' (e.g. loading 4B first then 1.7B fails, but single-CL 1.7B then 4B succeeds). The second model must also be pinned to a different device_id. Slot names are logical addresses for routing (e.g. 'tool_call', 'chat'); device_id assigns physical cores. See MANUAL.md, 'Multi Text Slots'.
_comment_poll: POLL:false turns off the HTP backend's busy-wait (measured on SA8255P: ~260% CPU for no latency gain). Remove it to keep whatever each model bundle sets.

TEXT_SLOTS._comment: First = the smaller model (tool_call / fast). Loading this first makes the pair load.
TEXT_SLOTS.name: tool_call

TEXT_SLOTS._comment: Second = the larger model (chat / quality) on a different device_id.
TEXT_SLOTS.name: chat
